rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for remembering or recollecting something.

example.english: I still recall the day I first met you.
example.traditional: 我仲記得第一次見你嗰日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 gei3 dak1 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 nei5 go2 jat6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for memory or a recollection.

example.english: I still have vivid recall of those events.
example.traditional: 我對嗰段往事仲有好深嘅記憶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 go2 dyun6 wong5 si6 zung6 jau5 hou2 sam1 ge3 gei3 jik1

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone’s ability to remember, rather than a remembered thing or recollection.

example.english: You have such a good recall that you can remember a phone number from so long ago?
example.traditional: 你記性咁好，咁耐嘅電話號碼都記得？
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 sing3 gam3 hou2 gam3 noi6 ge3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 dou1 gei3 dak1

rows.note: Use this when withdrawing words or taking back an order in ordinary speech.

example.english: I recall what I just said.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau1 faan1 tau4 sin1 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when calling or bringing someone back to a place or duty.

example.english: The boss will recall us for a meeting.
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 giu3 faan1 ngo5 dei6 lei4 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this for the official return of a faulty product, not ordinary recycling or collection.

example.english: These refrigerators have a problem, so the manufacturer announced a product recall.
example.traditional: 呢批雪櫃有問題，廠方宣布產品回收。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 syut3 gwai6 jau5 man6 tai4 cong2 fong1 syun1 bou3 caan2 ban2 wui4 sau1

rows.note: Use this when something evokes a memory or reminds someone of something.

example.english: This song makes me recall my childhood.
example.traditional: 呢首歌令人諗起我細個嗰陣。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 ling6 jan4 nam2 hei2 ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6

rows.note: Use this in political contexts for the recall system or procedure allowing voters to remove an official.

example.english: This country's recall system allows voters to vote to recall elected officials before their terms end.
example.traditional: 呢個國家嘅罷免制度，容許選民喺任期完之前投票罷免民選官員。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 baa6 min5 zai3 dou6 jung4 heoi2 syun2 man4 hai2 jam6 kei4 jyun4 zi1 cin4 tau4 piu3 baa6 min5 man4 syun2 gun1 jyun4
